subject: general
question: In which state of India is the Moatsu festival celebrated every year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Moatsu **is a festival commemorated by the People of **Nagaland.**
 
• This is a festival of community bonding commemorated in **May for 3 days.**
 
• The festival is celebrated in the Ao town of Mokokchung, which is approx **150 km away from Kohima. **
 
• As a celebration, the villagers show their friendship for each other by exchanging **presents, making new friends, feasting, bon fire etc.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cae05ef9ec9b6ca32ba55a2c512bfee60e4afe5d1389e65ffc56bc7340bc5d1a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pongal** is the most popular festival that is commemorated in **Tamil Nadu.**
 
• The **Hampi Festival**, celebrated in November, is one of the most significant festivals in** Karnataka** celebrated on a grand level.
 
• **​Sarhul **is the important festival of the tribal population of **Jharkhand. **
